works.title: Tombuto 3rd
works.author: Undefined
works.description:
Quite behind schedule, but always on time!
Thank you for watching and for being patient, sorry this took so long lmao

Actual serious comments about me:
I've been living a lot more outside of PS nowadays which unsurprisingly I wasn't doing much before, so my motivation to do edits, mod or even spin seriously hasn't been the same it used to be.
Despite that I simply pushed through the editing block and finally finished this damn thing, in a way that I can at least hold some pride on it. 
For quite a while one of the reasons I didn't touch it was because I didn't feel satisfied with the submissions, didn't get many outside of invites, and even a lot of my invites got turned down.
I don't think it's a mystery to anyone that pen spinning is slowing down immensely, I wasn't here before but I assume this is how it was before the 2020 pandemic which was when I and many others started. And with it so have I. 
I still just hope this video is enough to serve as a full display of what I could do and perhaps a satisfying final contribution to this stupid, shut-in, childish and cringy community that even though I feel like I grew out of, I still hold fond memories of...
Thanks for reading this rant, I still like ps but I have no clue how much longer I'll continue spinning and this might be the last 'big' project I ever edit.
Thank you all for having submitted and not being mad it took so long lol, thank you all for all the memories, thank you all for the fun times and for everything I've learned. Thank you.

See you around ❤

works.title: [SF] VPC 1st
works.author: Undefined
works.description:
Hi all, Walkaz here.

I proudly present to you VPC 1st - a representative work of the Vietnamese Pen spinning (PS) Club. Whether the bar is high or low, it is up to you to judge. Admittedly, VPC is not a strong board. VPC members are no longer active in PS as eventually, life catches up and priorities take over. Yet, for many of us, PS is still an important part of our lives as it was integral to our formative years so thus, VPC 1st was born - as a platform for us to get back together into a CV and for us to remember our good old times.

As you might have noticed, the music used was unorthodoxy and might be hard for some to appreciate. Fret not, for even Vietnamese find it hard to appreciate Tung Duong's abstract style of music. Despite the foreseeable reaction from the community, both local and international, I insisted on using this song. By using a Vietnamese song, not only have I created a video compilation of local spinners, but I also have input a sense of nationality into the work. It is easy for me to have use a DnB song and have a generic CV done without leaving much impression. However, I chose not to do so, as I wished to contribute to the diversity that Spinfest deserves. In my opinion, Spinfest is a celebration of diversity, not the contest of who can produce the most JEB-esque collab. Hence, I wished to make VPC 1st a truly Vietnamese CV and not any other CV by using this song - one of the many great songs during the summit of Vietnamese Music (before Pop and gibberish take over, ugh).

Having clarified my stance on music choice and what VPC 1st stood for, I hope you enjoy watching the CV as much as I do. Ciao!

HOURS OF FUN IN JUST 30 SECONDS! 

But seriously, more like hours of work :D As you probably know, the CV was open for public registration. In retrospect, this was a mistake. Out of the ~15 clips I got via public examination, one made it into the actual video (Alvaris). The remaining clips were either not good enough or I was unable to properly incorporate them into the video because they were too slow/not matching the theme of the CV (kirua and Nashi+Eriror, great Clips.
